# ReferralRock

ReferralRock is a referral marketing platform that helps businesses create and manage referral programs to drive word-of-mouth growth and customer acquisition

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/referralrock/.

## Actions

- **Add new member to program**: Create a new member and add them to a referral program.
- **Create New Referral**: Create a new referral in ReferralRock based on a member's referral code.
- **Generate Member Access Token**: Generate pre-authenticated member access URLs for sharing and portal experiences.
- **Generate Member Access URLs**: Generate member access URLs for custom share experience or secure portal embedding.
- **Get Member Statistics** (read-only): Retrieve comprehensive statistics for a single member from ReferralRock.
- **Get Referrals** (read-only): List referrals with filtering and pagination options.
- **Get Rewards** (read-only): List rewards with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Get Single Program** (read-only): Retrieve a single referral program by name.
- **Get Single Referral** (read-only): Retrieve a single referral by email, ID, or external ID.
- **Issue Reward to Member**: Issue a reward to a member in the Referral Rock system.
- **List Program Members** (read-only): List program members with filtering and pagination.
- **List Referral Programs** (read-only): List all referral programs in ReferralRock.
- **Create Invite Feed Entries**: Create multiple invite feed entries for automatic invites in ReferralRock.
- **Create Invite Feed Entry**: Create an invite feed entry for automatic invitations.
- **Create Referral Action**: Create a referral action for processing recurring rewards.
- **Create Webhook Subscription**: Create or update a webhook subscription for event notifications.
- **Delete Members from Program**: Delete members from a referral program.
- **Delete Referral**: Delete one or more referrals from a referral program.
- **Delete Rewards**: Delete rewards from members or referrals in a referral program.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook subscription.
- **Get Email Unsubscribed Status** (read-only): Check if an email address is unsubscribed from communications.
- **Get Payout** (read-only): Retrieve payout list by ID.
- **Get Payout Details by ID** (read-only): Get payout details by ID.
- **Get Payout Transactions** (read-only): Get payout transaction history for referral program participants.
- **Get Pending Payouts** (read-only): Get pending payouts for a member or recipient.
- **Get Reward Rules** (read-only): Get reward rules for a program.
- **Get Webhook History for Event** (read-only): Retrieve webhook history for a specific event.
- **Remove Email from Unsubscribe List**: Remove an email address from the unsubscribe list.
- **Remove Email from Unsubscribe List**: Remove an email address from the unsubscribe list.
- **Remove Members from Program**: Remove members from a referral program.
- **Remove Referral**: Remove referrals from a referral program.
- **Remove Rewards**: Remove rewards from members or referrals of a referral program.
- **Unsubscribe Email Address**: Unsubscribe an email address from the ReferralRock mailing list.
- **Update Referral Details**: Update referral details in a referral program.
- **Update Referral Status**: Update referral status in ReferralRock.
